units: <cite ref="Niddah 60b:39">Nidd. 60ᵇ</cite> <he>י׳ וזקן וכ׳</he> a young man and an old man travelling.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1:15">Ex. R. s. 1</cite>; <cite ref="Sotah 12b:9">Sot. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>הוא י׳ וקולו כנער</he> he (Moses) was an infant, but his voice was that of a lad.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 3:2:6">Y. Meg. III, 74ᵃ</cite> bot., v. <cite ref="A00039"><he>אֶבְדּוֹקוֹס</he></cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>יְלָדִים</he>. Ex. R. l. c. <he>קיימו את</he> (<he>החיו</he>) <he>הו׳</he> they spared the lives of the new-born.
Kidd. 76ᵇ, a. e. ד׳ מאות י׳ וכ׳ David had four hundred young men in his suite; a. fr.—Fem. יַלְדָּה girl, young woman.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 60b:12">B. Kam. 60ᵇ</cite> <he>אחת י׳ ואחת זקינה</he> one wife was young, the other old.
Sabb. 32ᵃ ר״א … מתות י׳ R. El. reports, ‘for three sins women die young’ (in place of יוֹלְדוֹת, v. יוֹלֶדֶת); Y. ib. II, 5ᵇ top.—Trnsf. יַלְּדָּה a young plant.
Men. 69ᵇ; Sot. 43ᵇ, a. e. י׳ שסבכה בזקנה a young shoot (subject to the law of Orlah, v. עָרְלָה) which was grafted on an old tree.
<cite ref="Sotah 43b:6">Ib.</cite> <he>י׳ בי׳</he> a young shoot grafted on a young tree.
